description: A stroppy workload: build, protocol, load segments, driver options and baseline.

fields.name: stroppy_version
fields.description: Stroppy build to run: a release (6.0.0) or a nightly of one commit (nightly-<sha>); must exist in the platform catalog. 6.0.0 is the minimum.

rules.message: stroppy releases before 6.0.0 are not supported

fields.title: Stroppy version

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Wire protocol stroppy talks to the database with.
fields.title: Protocol

fields.name: segments
fields.description: Ordered stroppy invocations; each one is a phase of the run.
fields.title: Segments

fields.name: driver
fields.description: Protocol-neutral stroppy driver options.

fields.name: default_insert_method
fields.description: Fallback for load requests that leave their method unset (defaultInsertMethod); workloads normally choose themselves.
fields.title: Insert method

fields.name: bulk_size
fields.description: Rows per bulk INSERT statement (bulkSize).
fields.title: Bulk size

fields.name: pool
fields.description: pool.* sugar mapped onto the driver's own pool config.

fields.name: max_conns
fields.description: pool.maxConns; should cover the VUs of the busiest segment.
fields.title: Max connections

fields.name: min_conns
fields.description: pool.minConns; warm connections opened up front.
fields.title: Min connections

fields.name: max_conn_lifetime
fields.description: pool.maxConnLifetime.
fields.title: Max connection lifetime

fields.name: max_conn_idle_time
fields.description: pool.maxConnIdleTime.
fields.title: Max idle time
Connection pool

fields.name: insert_progress
fields.description: insertProgress.* — load progress reporting.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: insertProgress.mode: where load progress goes.
fields.title: Mode

fields.name: interval
fields.description: insertProgress.interval — progress cadence.
fields.title: Interval

fields.name: stall_after
fields.description: insertProgress.stallAfter — warn when no rows moved for this long.
fields.title: Stall after
Load progress
Driver

fields.name: connection
fields.description: Protocol-specific connection options; the kind must match the protocol.

fields.name: sslmode
fields.description: TLS negotiation mode of the cockroach (pgwire) connection.
fields.title: SSL mode

fields.name: tls
fields.description: go-sql-driver TLS mode of the MySQL DSN.
fields.title: TLS

fields.name: charset
fields.description: Connection character set.
fields.title: Charset

fields.name: sslmode
fields.description: TLS negotiation mode of the postgres connection (URL sslmode).
fields.title: SSL mode

fields.name: application_name
fields.description: application_name reported to postgres; shows up in pg_stat_activity.
fields.title: Application name

fields.name: query_exec_mode
fields.description: pgx query execution mode (postgres.defaultQueryExecMode).
fields.title: Query exec mode

fields.name: query_exec_mode
fields.description: pgx execution mode. Exec avoids prepared-statement limits and binary parameter incompatibilities in Picodata 25.3 and 26.1.
fields.title: Query execution mode

fields.name: ca_cert
fields.description: PEM of a private CA (caCertFile), when the endpoint is not signed by a public one.
fields.title: CA certificate

fields.name: auth_token
fields.description: IAM token passed as authToken.
fields.title: Auth token

fields.name: auth_user
fields.description: Static credentials user (authUser).
fields.title: User

fields.name: auth_password
fields.description: Static credentials password (authPassword).
fields.title: Password

fields.name: tls_insecure_skip_verify
fields.description: tlsInsecureSkipVerify — testing only.
fields.title: Skip TLS verification
Connection

fields.name: baseline
fields.description: Machine self-check with `stroppy baseline`; its JSON report lands in the run result.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Run `stroppy baseline` on the runner machine before the segments: the stroppy ceiling a database run can never exceed.
fields.title: Measure the runner

fields.name: tiers
fields.description: Which tiers to run (--tiers); unset = both.
fields.title: Tiers

fields.name: quick
fields.description: Shorter phases and a smaller load (--quick).
fields.title: Quick

fields.name: vus
fields.description: VU count of the parallel tx phase (--vus); unset = 20.
fields.title: Parallel VUs

fields.name: rows
fields.description: Rows loaded into the probe table (--rows); unset = 250000.
fields.title: Load rows

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Duration of each tx phase (--duration); unset = 3s.
fields.title: Tx phase duration
Baseline

rules.expr: !("connection" in root) || !("protocol" in root) || root.connection.kind == (root.protocol.startsWith("ydb") ? "ydb" : root.protocol)
size(root.segments.map(s, s.name)) == size(root.segments.map(s, s.name).filter(n, root.segments.filter(x, x.name == n).size() == 1))

segment.description: One stroppy load segment: workload, typed parameters, scenario, steps and files.

fields.title: Name

Workload

fields.name: run
fields.description: Load shape of the segment.

fields.name: executor
fields.description: Scenario executor: constant-vus runs for a duration, shared-iterations shares N iterations between VUs.
fields.title: Executor

fields.name: vus
fields.description: Concurrent virtual users (vus); sizes the runner machine and the pool.
fields.title: Virtual users

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Wall-clock length of a constant-vus scenario (duration).
fields.title: Duration

fields.name: iterations
fields.description: Total iterations of a shared-iterations scenario (iterations).
fields.title: Iterations

fields.name: query_timeout
fields.description: Per-statement deadline (queryTimeout); 0 disables it.
fields.title: Query timeout
Scenario

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Run only the listed stroppy steps (--steps); empty = all steps.
fields.title: Only these steps

fields.name: no_steps
fields.description: Skip the listed stroppy steps (--no-steps); stroppy rejects it together with steps.
fields.title: Skip these steps

fields.name: extra_params
fields.description: Typed stroppy flags this form does not model, by flag name without dashes (load-workers); values are parsed by stroppy.

rules.message: extra parameter keys must be stroppy flag names (lower-kebab)

fields.title: Extra parameters

fields.name: files
fields.description: Extra files (SQL dialects, schemas, data) shipped with the segment.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name the file gets in the segment workspace; reference it from sql_file/schema_file.
fields.title: File name

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What the file is: a schema/DDL file, a config, or a data file.
fields.title: Kind

fields.name: content
fields.description: Inline file body, at most 1 MiB.
fields.title: Content

fields.name: ref
fields.description: Artifact/object reference to fetch instead of inline content.
fields.title: Reference

rules.message: a file needs exactly one of content or ref

fields.title: Files

fields.name: thresholds
fields.description: Pass/fail bounds the pipeline applies to the segment summary.

fields.name: p99_ms
fields.description: Fail the segment when iteration_duration p99 exceeds this.
fields.title: p99 latency

fields.name: error_rate
fields.description: Fail the segment when failed_iterations / iterations exceeds this (0..1).
fields.title: Error rate
Thresholds

fields.name: warmup
fields.description: Idle wait before the segment starts, letting caches and replicas settle.
fields.title: Warm-up

fields.name: log_level
fields.description: Minimum stroppy log level (--log-level); debug traces parameter resolution.
fields.title: Log level

rules.expr: !("steps" in root) || !("no_steps" in root) || size(root.steps) == 0 || size(root.no_steps) == 0
!("workload" in root) || root.workload.script != "execute_sql" || (("sql_body" in root.workload && root.workload.sql_body != null) != ("sql_file" in root.workload && root.workload.sql_file != null))
rules.message: execute_sql needs exactly one of sql_body or sql_file
